title: Longest and shortest track per album
statementMd:
For albums 1 to 5 show the album title, the shortest and the longest track length in seconds.

Expected columns: `title`, `shortest`, `longest`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT al.title, MIN(t.seconds) AS shortest, MAX(t.seconds) AS longest FROM albums al JOIN tracks t ON t.album_id = al.id WHERE al.id <= 5 GROUP BY al.id, al.title;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
